Monster.benchmark_note: Company-wide energy drink case equivalents across Monster and strategic brands, NOT just the Monster branded product; 192 oz equivalent cases.

Celsius.benchmark_note: CELSIUS brand reported quarterly net revenue; disclosed drivers include SKU optimization, inventory/shipment timing, and softness in club channels. Not evidence of disliked flavors.

Alani Nu.benchmark_note: Alani Nu reported quarterly net revenue; management cites distribution expansion, limited-edition flavor release and consumer demand. Acquisitions and channel mix constrain causal comparison.

Rockstar.benchmark_note: Q3 2026 reported Rockstar revenue was $80.3m, but no comparable Q3 2025 brand baseline is included in this project. Do not calculate YoY growth.
